subject: Exports & deletion for access/audit logs — Finvero regulatory request
messages:
From: Sara Malik <sara.malik@finvero.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: access & audit log export + proof of deletion

Hi Lukas —

Finvero has a regulatory request to produce access and audit logs for our tenant (finvero-prod) covering 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30. We need a full export for review and an assurance that after delivery the retained logs within your systems for that tenant will be removed per our retention agreement.

Questions:
- What export formats do you support (CSV/JSON/Parquet)?
- How long until we can get a first export? SLA?
- Can you provide a signed proof of deletion once Redwood removes the retained export artifacts and any extra copies?

I attached a short schema that lists the fields our auditors expect.

Thanks,
Sara Malik
Compliance Manager, Finvero
Attachment: export_schema.csv (CSV)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malik <sara.malik@finvero.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: access & audit log export + proof of deletion

Hi Sara — thanks for the detail and the schema. We're able to support CSV, newline-delimited JSON, and Parquet exports. I looped in Marissa (engineering) and Karthik (support/ops) to confirm region residency constraints and the handoff steps.

Initial plan:
1) We'll validate tenant and timeframe, run a scoped export (redacted by default for PII unless you request full fields).
2) Delivery options: SFTP to your secure bucket, or a time-limited signed HTTPS download (TLS + signed URL).
3) After you confirm receipt and checksum, we'll schedule deletion of the export artifacts from our systems and provide a signed deletion confirmation.

Couple of clarifying asks:
- Please confirm if the export needs to leave the EU region (Finvero legal)?
- Who should receive the SFTP credentials / signed link?
- Any field-level redaction required beyond the schema?

I'll open an internal ticket and propose a 48–72 hour turnaround after we get the OK and credentials.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara.malik@finvero.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: access & audit log export + proof of deletion

On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 10:03 AM Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'll open an internal ticket and propose a 48–72 hour turnaround after we get the OK and credentials.

Confirming operational playbook here (high level):
- Scope: we will pull audit.log and access.log sets for the tenant id finvero-prod across the requested dates.
- Formats: default Parquet (columnar) for efficiency; can also emit NDJSON or CSV per the attached schema.
- Delivery: prefer SFTP to a customer-managed host (you provide endpoint & creds) or a presigned HTTPS expiring link (7 days default).
- Security: exports encrypted at rest with customer-specific KMS wrapping during transit if requested. Checksums (SHA256) generated for each file.
- Deletion: once Finvero confirms file integrity and acceptance, we will purge export artifacts from our staging buckets and worker nodes. We keep audit trails of the deletion itself (not the exported content) and will provide a signed confirmation PDF (signed by Redwood legal/ops).
- Time: typical SLA 48–72 business hours, may extend to 5 business days for very large windows (>2 TB) or cross-region retrievals.

Operational caveat: if tenant is EU-resident and Finvero requires that exported material remain in-region, we need to push the export to an EU-hosted destination (SFTP endpoint in EU or your EU bucket). If you need us to STAY in-region and you ask us to also delete internal copies, we will not copy the export out of eu-1; we'll provide access via a transient link to EU-hosted storage.

I'll create ticket REDWOOD-4321 and attach the playbook checklist.

— Karthik (Support Engineering)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malik <sara.malik@finvero.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 13:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: access & audit log export + proof of deletion

Quick technical notes:
- EU tenant note: Finvero-prod is resident in eu-1 (I checked). For exports that include IPs and user identifiers we recommend using our redaction tool unless you have a Data Processing Addendum that allows movement.
- Export size estimate: for the 3-month window expect ~120 GB compressed in Parquet (depends on retention verbosity). If Finvero wants raw verbose logs including KV cache traces, bump estimate accordingly.
- Deletion proof: we can produce (1) a system deletion record (timestamp + operator), (2) storage-level object tombstone logs, and (3) a signed ops statement. We do not publish raw deletion logs to customers, but will provide the signed statement and the internal tombstone ids for audit.

If Finvero needs an anonymized sample to validate the schema before the full export, we can deliver a 24-hour sample within 24 hours.

— Marissa (Infra Eng)
From: Sara Malik <sara.malik@finvero.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance_ops@finvero.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:31:00 -0800

Thanks, team. Confirming:
- Finvero requires the export to remain in EU unless a data transfer addendum is signed. Please keep the export in-region and provide an EU-hosted signed link to download.
- We will accept Parquet; add a NDJSON option if Parquet fails schema checks.
- Please send the 24-hour sample for 2026-10-01 ASAP so our auditors can confirm field mapping.

I attached the signed mandate for this data request. If you can start the sample today, we appreciate it.

Sara
